notes.li: Important: MF Vanilla can hide vanilla technology research so your colony grows through spellcraft, reagents, enchanted workshops, arcane sites, and magical discoveries instead of the standard industrial path.
Settings: use the MF Vanilla settings page to restore vanilla technology research or turn off the reminder if you want the standard tech tree.

The magic economy is now much more complete: grow herbs, prepare papyrus or parchment, grind gemstone dust, brew arcane ink, scribe scrolls, cut gems, craft elemental foci, and build toward advanced enchantment.
Gifted pawns grow as spellcasters through arcane research, scribing, alchemy, and enchantment work, unlocking higher-level spells through play instead of dev tools.
Arcane treasure chests now appear as magical reward caches, packed with scrolls, gems, silver, gold, enchanted prizes, rare materials, and other discoveries.
New arcane cache sites create compact magical mission maps with deterministic layouts, reward chests, themed dressing, and construct guardians.
The Arcane Forge is ready for ambitious colonies, letting skilled enchanters transform quality weapons into elemental arms powered by linked arcane spires.

Enchanted weapons now have clearer identities: Zephyr Spear, Flaming Longsword, Tidebreaker Mace, and Stonefall Mace provide a mix of activated powers, passive protections, melee triggers, and elemental flavor.
Arcane constructs and automata now guard higher-value sites, including clay automata, rune-slashers, crystal sentinels, rune-ballista constructs, and the rare Deep Iron Golem.
Stay tuned: future updates are planned to add leyline gameplay, elemental cultures, expanded elemental schools, deeper arcane sites, and more magical world events.
You can reopen the latest notes from the MF Vanilla settings page.
